== Description ==

[[Jack Douglass]] (front table left, blue beaver-logo tee, glasses, hair bun), [[Mark Billings]] (front table right, ponytail, black/gold top & Mario Kart tee), [[Ken Cross]] (front table foreground right, short grey-blond hair, glasses, black tee), [[Brian Fred]] (stream table right seat (back), bald, glasses, black tee, black shorts), [[Daniel Amor]] (middle table, green hoodie, glasses), [[Nathan Russell]] (middle table, dark grey Mario tee, glasses, balding), [[Scott Lingrell]] (middle table (back), white hair, navy pullover, khaki shorts), [[Ming Huo]] (middle table front-right (back), grey tee, khaki shorts), [[Logan Pietig]] (mid-back table, black UWL hoodie, white shoes), [[Jonny Chu]] (mid-back table, black zip hoodie over purple tee), [[Anthony Howard]] (mid-back table facing camera, black tee, dark beard), and [[Hayes Hunter]] (standing back right, tall bearded man in dark grey shirt, jeans) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 3 October 2025.
